title: Tyson and the Villains Who Gave Up
description: Two goofy villains capture Tyson to stop his fun. Big mistake: he torments them with tag, 400 knock-knock jokes, and dance battles until they beg to take him home.
subtitle: A comic about endless tag, 400 knock-knock jokes, and a dance battle that defeats the fun-stoppers. Inspired by “The Ransom of Red Chief,” retold as a silly comic.

cover.alt: Comic cover page: Zorp the grumpy alien and Vacky the villainous vacuum peek from behind a bush, spying on Tyson's tag game, and hatch a plan to stop all fun.

blocks.alt: Comic page 1 of 12: Zorp the grumpy alien and Vacky the villainous vacuum peek from behind a bush, spying on Tyson's tag game, and hatch a plan to stop all fun.
blocks.caption: Page 1 of 12 — The Fun Stoppers

blocks.html:
Zorp: “TOO MUCH FUN!”
Vacky: “WE MUST STOP IT!”
Zorp: “WE'LL CAPTURE TYSON!”
Tyson: “TAG! YOU'RE IT!”

blocks.alt: Comic page 2 of 12: a big butterfly net drops over Tyson — and he treats being captured like the best ride ever.
blocks.caption: Page 2 of 12 — The Capture

blocks.html:
GOTCHA!
Tyson: “WHEEE!”
Zorp: “TO THE HIDEOUT!”
Tyson: “BEST RIDE EVER!”

blocks.alt: Comic page 3 of 12: inside the cardboard castle, Zorp writes a ransom note in giant crayon while Tyson plays with a toy car. Mom reads it on the porch, totally calm.
blocks.caption: Page 3 of 12 — The Ransom Note

blocks.html:
AT THE HIDEOUT...
WE HAVE TYSON. NO FUN ALLOWED.
Mom: “TAKE YOUR TIME!”
Dad: “HE'LL WEAR THEM OUT.”

blocks.alt: Comic page 4 of 12: game one is tag. Tyson taps Zorp and sprints off; Vacky tangles in its own hose; both villains end up collapsed panting on the grass.
blocks.caption: Page 4 of 12 — Game One: Tag

blocks.html:
Tyson: “TAG! YOU'RE IT!”
Zorp: “I'M TOO OLD FOR THIS!”
Vacky: “MY HOSE!”
Tyson: “AGAIN! AGAIN!”

blocks.alt: Comic page 5 of 12: Tyson raps knock-knock jokes until the wall counter reads joke number 387 and both villains droop.
blocks.caption: Page 5 of 12 — 400 Knock-Knock Jokes

blocks.html:
Tyson: “KNOCK KNOCK!”
Zorp: “WHO'S THERE?”
Tyson: “BANANA!”
Zorp: “BANANA WHO?”
JOKE #387!
Vacky: “NO MORE BANANAS!”

blocks.alt: Comic page 6 of 12, a widescreen split: Tyson breakdances on the grass, then Zorp and Vacky attempt a robot dance and topple over each other.
blocks.caption: Page 6 of 12 — Dance Battle

blocks.alt: Comic page 7 of 12, a full-page splash: the whole backyard dance-off under a silly cardboard disco ball, with giant BOOGIE! WOOGIE! lettering, Shane and the dog dancing at the edges, Zorp dizzy and Vacky spinning.
blocks.caption: Page 7 of 12 — THE ULTIMATE DANCE-OFF!

blocks.html:
THE WHOLE BACKYARD IS DANCING!
BOOGIE! WOOGIE! BOOGIE! WOOGIE!

blocks.alt: Comic page 8 of 12, Flip-O-Rama frame A: the backyard — tree with cardboard disco ball on the left, cardboard castle at the right edge — Tyson center in dance pose A, one arm up and one leg kicked out, and one giant word fills the frame: BOOGIE!
blocks.caption: Page 8 of 12 — Flip-O-Rama A: BOOGIE!

blocks.alt: Comic page 9 of 12, Flip-O-Rama frame B: the exact same backyard, the exact same characters — but Tyson is in the opposite dance pose and the giant word is WOOGIE! Flip the two frames fast and Tyson dances: BOOGIE! WOOGIE!
blocks.caption: Page 9 of 12 — Flip-O-Rama B: WOOGIE!

blocks.alt: Comic page 10 of 12: the exhausted villains beg — Zorp on his knees, Vacky waving a white flag — while Tyson is confused, because they just started.
blocks.caption: Page 10 of 12 — Please Take Him Back!

blocks.html:
Zorp: “PLEASE! TAKE HIM BACK!”
Vacky: “WE GIVE UP!”
Tyson: “BUT WE JUST STARTED!”
Zorp: “NEVER AGAIN!”

blocks.alt: Comic page 11 of 12: Zorp and Vacky fly Tyson home in their silly cardboard rocket, and Zorp hands him a giant rainbow lollipop as a parting gift.
blocks.caption: Page 11 of 12 — The Ride Home

blocks.html:
Zorp: “HOME AT LAST!”
Tyson: “BEST DAY EVER!”
Mom: “THAT WAS FAST!”
Zorp: “PLEASE... NEVER COME BACK.”

blocks.alt: Comic page 12 of 12: back home on the porch at sunset, Tyson waves 'See you tomorrow!' while behind him the fainted villains lie in a heap on the grass, X-eyes and tongues out, a tiny white flag still tied to Vacky's hose, as the dog licks the giant lollipop.
blocks.caption: Page 12 of 12 — See You Tomorrow!

blocks.html:
Tyson: “SEE YOU TOMORROW!”
Z-Z-Z...
Zorp: “no more tag...”

discussionHtml:
💭 Bedtime Chat

Tyson never fought the villains — he just out-played them. What's the funniest way you've ever won a game?

🏷️ More Fun Beats No Fun Zorp and Vacky wanted to stop fun, but Tyson answered with MORE fun — tag, jokes, and dancing — until the fun-stoppers gave up. Joy is a pretty good superpower.
🍭 The Lollipop Peace Prize The villains even gave Tyson a giant lollipop to take him home. Sometimes the best ending is everyone laughing — even the villains.

artDirection.style: Dav Pilkey Dog Man graphic-novel comic style: thick wobbly hand-drawn black felt-tip ink outlines, flat gouache and crayon color fills, off-white paper texture. Each scene is one full comic page with dynamic layouts (grids, 3-panel pages, a widescreen split, a full-page splash, and a two-frame Flip-O-Rama dance). Wardrobe lock: only Tyson wears the blue-and-white checkered shirt; Shane solid green tee; Dad brown sweater; Mom purple top. Villains: Zorp is a short round green alien with star-tipped antennae, purple cape, silver boots; Vacky is a round silver vacuum robot on wheels with a trunk-like hose snout, tiny black top hat, dust-bag.
